text:
Alex: Quick thought — our postmortem actions feel like they fall off after the doc is published. Can we try a lightweight 'runnerboard' + short weekly tuck-in to keep ownership visible?
Maria: +1. runnerboard = a filtered board on issues with status/resolution dates?
Sam: I like the tuck-in idea. 15min Friday sync to surface any actions slipping past 2w.
Priya: Prefer async first: assign owners + ETA on the PM doc, then weekly sync only for at-risk ones.
Jordan: Agree w/ Priya. Also we should flag recurring incident patterns automatically. Does anyone want to own adding recurrence detection to the postmortem template?
Alex: Good call. Proposal:
- Add fields in the template: owner, target-eta (YYYY-MM-DD), recurrence-tags, risk-level
- Create a runnerboard view that shows overdue actions and recurrence-tagged incidents
- Weekly 15m "tuck-in" that only includes items with <=2w left or overdue
Maria: That sounds actionable. Can we add a short SLA: owners must update status weekly or the IC becomes temporary owner? :thinking: 
Sam: We used a temporary owner escalation in prior orgs and it worked. Maybe: if no update in 7 days, oncall-bot pings owner + a fallback owner.
oncall-bot: Reminder: please update your postmortem action items. See https://example.com/runnerboard :bell:
Priya: For recurrence detection, suggestion: if the same service+error stack appears in 3 PMs within 90 days, auto-tag as recurring. Then route to platform reliability for deeper investigation.
Jordan: Love the 3-in-90 rule. We should also store a short repro snippet in the template so triage is faster.
Alex: Draft template snippet (for the postmortem doc):
```
- action: short description
- owner: @handle
- target_eta: 2026-04-10
- status: todo/in-progress/done
- recurrence_tags: [service, error-code]
- last_update: 2026-03-15
- notes: 1-2 lines
```
Maria: Can someone spin up the runnerboard filter and add a webhook so oncall-bot posts a weekly digest? I can own the board setup if Sam owns the webhook.
Sam: I can take the webhook. I'll make it post a one-line digest to #eng-oncall every Monday morning with counts: overdue / due-this-week / recurring.
Priya: Who will maintain the IC rotation list? We should make it a small pool and add a short role doc: responsibilities during tuck-ins + how to trigger escalation.
Jordan: I'll start a short doc (2-3 paragraphs) for IC responsibilities and escalation rules.
Alex: Awesome. Owners so far: Maria -> runnerboard filter; Sam -> webhook/digest; Jordan -> IC role doc; Priya -> recurrence tagging logic prototype. I'll add a 'runnerboard-setup' action to the PM and assign owners + 2-week ETA.
Maria: Quick Q — where do we track owners in GitHub vs Confluence? Keep everything on the PM doc and sync to GH issues via the webhook?
Sam: We can auto-create GH issues from runnerboard rows for any action that is code-related. Non-code ops stay in the doc.
Priya: If recurrence is detected, auto-create a high-priority GH issue and ping platform.
Alex: Plan: set this up this week, run pilot for 4 incidents, then iterate. If this works we make it part of postmortem closure checklist.
Jordan: sounds good. I'll post a short poll for tuck-in times.
Alex: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem template now and add the initial actions. :thumbsup:
